title: BTS Open Asia Leg of ARIRANG World Tour at Kaohsiung National Stadium
detail: BTS began the Asia and Australia leg of the ARIRANG world tour in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, with further shows on Nov 21 and 22. The city lit landmarks purple, including the 85 Sky Tower, and ran a BUS 613 shuttle. Korea Times also reports BTS won Most Popular International Artist at the 2026 ARIA Awards.

media.caption: BTS brings purple wave to Kaohsiung as Asia tour kicks off
